verdict.rationale: Datalab documents explicit size/page limits and instructs users to manually segment large documents using page_range, plus checkpoint/save_checkpoint features to avoid re-parsing — indicating large-file handling requires workarounds rather than being fully automatic and reliable out-of-the-box. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic handling of thousand-page or multi-gigabyte files without truncation, documented timeout limits/behavior, and independent confirmation of reliability at scale.
